kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يجتذب (form VIII)
# يَجْتَذِبُ (yajtaḏibu) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ði.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# يُجْتَذَبُ (yujtaḏabu) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ða.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# يَجْتَذِبَ (yajtaḏiba) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ði.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
